text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's almost time to go abroad! I can't afford to run anything less than my absolute best at my last domestic race!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My opponent today is Biko Pegasus, who aspires to be a hero. I'm no hero myself, but I'll show her exactly what I am in today's race!
